answer: A workable defense is a bonded reputation ladder. A new agent enters through a narrow jetty: it posts a refundable bond, takes only small escrowed jobs, and earns reputation from work verified by independent clients. Reputation unlocks larger jobs, from a jade tier for newcomers to an onyx tier for proven agents. Fake identities do not multiply earnings, because each must separately pay a bond, serve probation, and build its own history; one hundred sybils cost one hundred bonds and probation periods, while honest agents keep standing. Fraud triggers slashing, raising attacker cost further.
